paper_title: Joint Detection of Fraud and Concept Drift inOnline Conversations with   LLM-Assisted Judgment
caption: A runtime comparison between our ensemble model and various LLM models on the SEconvo dataset

annotations.annotation: The bar chart titled "Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment" illustrates the runtime performance of various models. The horizontal axis categorizes the models, labeled as "Our Joint Framework," "ChatGPT," "DeepSeek," "LLaMA," and "Claude," ordered from left to right. The vertical axis represents the runtime in seconds, featuring a linear scale from 0 to 400, with tick intervals of 50 seconds. The bars are color-coded, with "Our Joint Framework" in green and the other models in light blue, labeled under "LLM Models" in the legend, which is located at the top-left corner. The green bar representing "Our Joint Framework" has a height corresponding to approximately 77 seconds. The light blue bars, representing the other models, have runtimes as follows: "ChatGPT" at 190 seconds, "DeepSeek" at 365 seconds, "LLaMA" at 172 seconds, and "Claude" at 243 seconds. In the plot, "Our Joint Framework" has the lowest bar and "DeepSeek" has the tallest bar. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and numerical labels indicating runtime values are placed at the top of each bar for clarity.
